assumptions: Unspecified microgrid capacity is assumed to be 50kW per site for preliminary estimation.

risks.title: Customs delays for imported equipment
risks.mitigation: Engage local customs brokers early and expedite shipping paperwork.

risks.title: Site security and accessibility issues in Haiti
risks.mitigation: Partner with local community leaders and secure private transport.

independent_review.summary: Coverage maps all four mandatory deliverables across T1, T2, T3-T12 and T13 for all ten confirmed Haiti sites. Calculated budget totals $2,171,600 against the $2,500,000 limit; calculated schedule is 200 days against the 365-day deadline. No false coverage labels, missing mandatory work or required-labor double counting are present. Estimates are unverified but transparently disclosed. Verdict: consistent. Verification hinges on confirmed actual start dates because T3-T12 are scheduled concurrently.
estimate_concerns: /unverified engineering specifications/cost realism are explicitly disclosed as preliminary estimates.
recommendations: Obtain vendor quotes, site capacities, load profiles, permits and site access before execution.
Replace placeholder AI estimates with substantiated pricing and confirm actual scheduled start dates for parallel site work.

findings.message: All task costs are unverified AI estimates lacking vendor quotes or site-specific engineering data.
findings.recommended_correction: Substantiate T1-T13 estimates with actual quotes and verified site specifications before commitment.
